commands.title: Open doc
commands.description: Show a Markdown (.md, .markdown) or mermaid (.mmd) file rendered, with diagrams drawn, or an HTML page (.html, .htm) running with JS, in a popup over the user's workspace; it takes focus and updates while the file changes. Call it after you write a spec, plan or report the user should read now; it also shows the doc as a card under your reply. Mention docs as a Markdown link or `path` in your reply freely, the user can click them; docs you only mention are folded under one small "N docs mentioned" row, so call docs_present (or docs_open) for the ones the user should look at. For interactive reports and UI mockups write ONE self-contained .html: inline CSS and JS, libraries only from cdnjs.cloudflare.com, cdn.jsdelivr.net, unpkg.com or esm.sh, no network calls (fetch, XHR and WebSockets are blocked), no iframes or forms; use the CSS variables --bg --text --muted --accent --border --code-bg --success --warning --danger --font --code-font to match the app; then call docs_open with it. Only files inside the workspace's folders, their git worktrees and agent uploads open; fails with not in workspace, not a document, too large (over 4 MiB) or not found.

path.description: File to show; absolute, or relative to the session's worktree (else the workspace's first folder).

session.description: Agent session whose worktree a relative path is resolved against; default the calling session.

commands.title: Present doc
commands.description: Show a doc or artifact you wrote to the user as a card under your reply, without opening it. Use it for the few docs the user should look at (a spec, plan, report or artifact), at most a few per reply; docs you only mention in your reply stay folded under one small "N docs mentioned" row. Takes the same files as docs_open: Markdown, mermaid or HTML inside the workspace's folders, their git worktrees and agent uploads; fails with not in workspace, not a document, too large (over 4 MiB) or not found. Non-destructive.

path.description: File to present; absolute, or relative to the session's worktree (else the workspace's first folder).

title.description: Card title; default the doc's first # heading (an artifact's <title>), else its file name.

session.description: Agent session whose reply gets the card; default the calling session.

commands.title: Read doc
commands.description: Render a Markdown or mermaid file of the workspace to an HTML fragment, or return an HTML page as is; the path stays watched and docs.changed is published when it changes.

path.description: File to read; absolute, or relative to the workspace's first folder.

title.description: First # heading (an artifact's <title>), else the file name.

html.description: HTML fragment for the document template, or the whole page for an artifact.

rev.description: Revision of the file, grows on every change.

kind.description: markdown for .md, .markdown and .mmd; artifact for .html and .htm.

commands.title: List docs
commands.description: List the workspace's docs (.md, .markdown, .mmd, .html, .htm): the ones agent sessions wrote first, newest first, then every other one git does not ignore, by rel; at most 2000. With session, only that session's docs; the home workspace lists only agents' docs. Only files that exist and are in the workspace's scope.

session.description: Agent session whose docs to list; omit for the whole workspace.

ifNoneMatch.description: The etag of an earlier result: when the list is the same, the reply is only {unchanged: true, etag}.

since.description: Returns {docs, removed, order?, cursor, delta, truncated} instead of the list (ifNoneMatch is then ignored). Pass "" for every doc and a cursor; pass an earlier result's cursor for only the docs that changed since then (delta true), the paths removed since then and order (every path in list order) when the order changed.

rel.description: Path relative to its folder, prefixed with the folder's name when the workspace has several; the absolute path for a doc outside the folders.

kind.description: markdown for .md, .markdown and .mmd; artifact for .html and .htm.

truncated.description: More docs exist than were returned.

etag.description: Hash of docs and truncated; pass it back as ifNoneMatch.

removed.description: With since: paths no longer listed after the cursor.

order.description: With since and delta: every path in list order, only when the order changed after the cursor.

cursor.description: With since: pass it as since next time.

delta.description: With since: true when docs holds only what changed after the cursor.

unchanged.description: True when ifNoneMatch matched; docs and truncated are then absent.
